programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: One of the hottest vehicles to hit the gear head world is the Side-by-Side, or Utility Vehicle. Once relegated to just farm or ranch work, the UTV is now something that you will see being used for Hunting, Fishing, Camping, Landscaping….virtually ANY kind of outdoor work or recreation. Of course that means the aftermarket is full of things to make an UTV better. Today on GEARZ, Stacey takes a Polaris Ranger and decks it out with a 3 ½” lift, bigger tires and axles, winches front and rear, and all kinds of other cool things to build an all-terrain vehicle that will really shine on the trail or off. After that he gives you a sneak peek at the new Ironworker that has everybody talking. If you work a lot with metal, you need this machine!

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: Stacey puts a programmer on the Drag ‘N’ Wagon to finally bring the stripped down Ram Hot Rod truck to life. If you’ve been wondering what kind of performance potential these new Ram Express trucks have, wait until you see one lit up with a supercharger! Talk about breathing fire! After that Stacey lays out how to set up a shop with custom flooring, custom cabnets, and of course a lot of tools and toolboxes. If you’ve ever wondered about the best way to lay out a shop, and utilize your space, this is the show to see… and GEARZ is the show to watch!

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: Project Heavy Metal is back as Stacey rolls the International Cabover truck into the shop so he can outfit it with a vintage Holmes dual wrecker bed. The big truck continues to come together using parts from a junkyard wrecker, swap meet vintage beer kegs, and some new aftermarket parts. If you always thought that you had to spend big money to build a unique vehicle, this “Heavy Metal” truck will change your mind, and probably have you digging through junkyards in hopes of finding a vintage truck of your own!

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: Everybody wants a classic short bed pickup. Unfortunately, short beds are hard to find for a good price… but long beds are a dime-a-dozen, and cheap! The solution?... chop a long bed down! That is exactly what Stacey does on this episode of GEARZ. He takes a classic 67 Chevy long bed, and walks you through the way to cut the frame properly, so you have a safe and reliable truck when you are done. If you’ve heard about this kind of modification, but always thought it was too difficult or involved for you to do, you need to watch this episode of GEARZ and let the cutting begin!

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: Who put men on the moon? If you answered “Gearheads” then you are right… of course, we call them engineers and rocket scientists now. But that doesn’t change the fact that a bunch of hot rodders figured out how to get America into Space, and Stacey takes a look at the roots of the Space Program, and the invention of the moon buggy. Then it’s out to the NASA testing grounds to see the annual Moon buggy race. If you think you’ve seen some weird projects, wait until you see what some of these young minds have dreamed up. You may think you’re on another planet, but you’re not… you’re watching GEARZ!

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: Stacey picks up right where he left off a few weeks ago and proceeds to install a brand new short bed, on the chassis of a truck that was born a LONG BED. That’s right, with the cutting done, the next step is to assemble a new short bed using all new aftermarket parts. You hear people say, “if it was that easy, everybody would be doing it!” Well, it IS that easy, and a lot of people ARE doing it… and YOU need to be one of them! Now… chop to it!

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: It was one of the most lethal airplanes of WWII… the P-38 Lightning. Stacey takes a look at what made it so unique and why the German army nicknamed it the “Forked tailed devil”. But the legend didn’t end in the 1940’s… it continues on as Stacey showcases the new P-38 engine parts from Jon Kaase that you can put on your small block Ford to make it run like greased lightning! After that, Stacey sits down with Rock and Roll legend and certified car nut, James Burton, to dig into the unique connection between cars, guitars, and Rock and roll. Turn it on… crank it up… and hold on!

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: Some of the most neglected tools around the house are lawn and garden tools. Mowers, weed-eaters, chain saws, etc. all usually get thrown in a garage in the fall, never to be touched again until spring. Stacey walks through the simple steps on how to care for those tools, so they give you years of trouble free service. After that, He goes through the many parts you will need to put a manual transmission into a project, with Transmission Tech. Finally, if you’re looking for a simple project to do over the weekend, how about a muffler swap? You say “no”?... Stacey says “yes.”

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: The V8 Interceptor is BACK and wearing a striking coat of glossy black paint! How did it happen? Well, Stacey walks you through the process and shows off the incredible paint and body work that was done by the Hot Rod Institute. From the subtle body nips and tucks, to the major fabrication of a new roof, this classic Cougar now has a straighter body than anything that may have rolled off the assembly line in 1967! But the paint is only half the story, as Stacey starts to re-assemble the car with bumpers, lights and engine, you start to get a good look at what is rapidly becoming the ultimate street predator!

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: What is cooler than a vintage tow truck? … Nothing! Stacey proves that point by rolling Heavy Metal back into the GEARZ shop to outfit it with new electric winches, and an amazing custom tool box and light bar. This ’69 International cabover truck may have been rescued from a junkyard, but it won’t be long before this truck starts pulling off rescues of its own! This is recycling at it’s best! Then ride along with Stacey and crew as they travel to Minnesota and get the story on Edwards Manufacturing and how they have managed to stay in business for over a hundred years building simple tools. It’s all good, and it’s all GEARZ!!

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: When you say “HEMI”, you get people’s attention! But when you say “Ray Barton HEMI” you win races. Stacey and crew take you to Ray Barton Racing Engines to show you the amazing engines and parts they build, and why they go so fast. After that, Stacey digs into the interior of the V8 Interceptor and shows what kind of options you have when you are restoring or customizing the interior of your project. You’ll love the custom PRS guitar and matching wood dash and steering wheel! There is no doubt that this Cougar is the perfect blend of brutal power, and sophisticated elegance.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: Stacey rolls in SGT. ROCK to take care of steering, brakes, and the exhaust system. With a quick trip to Stainless Works for a custom set of headers and exhaust system, and with the layout of the four-wheel hydraulic steering, it won’t be long before this big military beast is rolling under its own power. After that, he takes on the seat in Heavy Metal tow truck. Just because a project may have come out of a junkyard, doesn’t mean it has to look like junk. Stacey proves that by adding a custom bomber-style seat to this already VERY unique vehicle… this episode of GEARZ is the one to see!

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: Stacey sets out to build a nice hunting rig out of a 2012 GMC 4x4 truck. But this rig belongs to John Godwin of Duck Commander, which means the truck will be spending some serious time on the road… and off… hunting for ducks. On goes a 6” lift, 35” tall tires, and massive bumpers and winch to pull this big white beast out of any mud holes it may end up in. And since it IS such a big white beast, it is only fitting that Stacey name this project “Moby Duck”! If you’ve ever wondered if it’s possible to have a daily driver, that can also be a nice hunting, fishing, or outdoor rig. This episode of GEARZ will show you how to do it.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.sub-title: Super Car, Hot Rods, Go Carts
programme.desc: Stacey rolls the SL-C back into the shop to show off the twin turbo system Schwartz Performance installed. If you thought 1000hp out of an LS-7 was impossible, THINK AGAIN! Even wilder is the fact that this engine is pulling that kind of horsepower on pump gas! If supercars and twin turbos are your thing, you have to see this! After that, Stacey goes through some of the problem areas that you will face when you are building a vehicle and how to pick the right project. Finally He digs into the 1st motorized vehicle that most of us had…the Go-Kart. There's something for everybody in this show. That’s why they call it GEARZ!

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: The focus has shifted, with parts having arrived at the shop it’s time to install the Grill, Bumper, Dash and Interior of our 1968 Turbine Bronze Charger. Mark and the Ghouls work their magic on the Charger until a familiar face shows up. With Royal there, Mark shifts the crew back to the 1 of 2 1970 Coronet and finishes the interior. Then, it’s time for a test drive!

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: With SEMA 2018 looming on the horizon, it’s time to address the elephant in the room. Mark’s 1964 A100 Hemi truck, the Little Dead Wagon, built as an homage to Bill Maverick’s Little Red Wagon. Will is set to prime and paint, but has a disagreement with Mark over the color. When the engine for the A100 shows up it’s time to unbox one of the most powerful engines Graveyard Carz has ever put in a car!

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: Mark and the Ghouls get down to work like never before in order to get the A100 ready for SEMA which is only weeks away. Brakes, suspension, tail lights, bed sealer, you name it and the Mopar Maniacs are racing to get it done. With time flying and stress mounting the team works long hours and weekends trying to finish this iconic build. With SEMA only days away, the A100 finally gets it’s iconic 426 HEMI engine, well, if they can make it fit!

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.sub-title: Night of the Little Dead Wagon
programme.desc: There is no time left, SEMA is almost here but the iconic A100 still needs some buttoning up. Installing all of the final components is an all hands on deck task and when the dust settles, Mark has only the decals left to put on the car, completing its legendary look. With the A100 finished the team heads out to SEMA in order to roll the Little Dead Wagon over the red carpet for Mopar and Mark once again receives a very kind gift from our friends.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: When Mark get’s started talking about a car there is almost no stopping him. So it is again when Mark picks multiple years of a favorite Mopar of his and tells both the audience, and whoever will listen all about their amazing options and cool differences. The Ghouls join in on the fun just like last time to pick their favorite things as well. Don’t worry, though, he can’t talk forever right?

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: With SEMA over the Ghoulz can finally rest and get back to work on all the cars they had to leave untouched for the last few weeks…again. First up on deck is our beautiful 1972 Duster. Needing its Dash installed as well as its interior there is still a lot of work left on this car! Additionally, metal work has begun on a host of new cars moving up through the shop, it never stops at Graveyard Carz.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: A 1970 Challenger is a special thing, but a B5 Challenger is even more special. With the bumblebee stripe finally added to the car it’s time for the work to really begin. Work begins on all the things that make this 1970 Challenger special, including the headliner, dash, interior and more. With that done it’s time for this beautiful Challenger to get its 440 Six Pack!

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: The time has finally come. Brett Torino is coming and he is here for his car, the legendary 1 of 2 ever made, 1970 Coronet! Mark wouldn’t be Mark, though, without a few tricks up his sleeve. When Brett arrives to collect on his long restoration from the Mopar Master, the reveal of this truly one of a kind car is done with style. But not before Mark takes us back through the entire restoration leading up to that point. It Is the last 1970 Hemi Coronet Convertible on earth, after all.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: The crew is overwhelmed with several restorations at once. From painting stripes, to engine parts, to missing parts on the 71 Charger, tensions are high around the shop. To Make things worse, Mark is obsessed with finding a factory pink Mopar for his granddaughter's 16th birthday.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.sub-title: It's the Great Pumpkin, Mark Worman!
programme.desc: The crew at Graveyard Carz are excited about the pumpkin carving contest, but when a mistake leaves the 'Cuda filled with water, the whole crew has to pay the price. Royal saves the day, but with the carving contest back on the table, where are the pumpkins? Mark has to swallow his pride and accept help from Daren for the contest to go ahead.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: Daren is given control of the shop for a week. Darenʼs constant pestering and ribbing leads Mark to hand him the reigns of Graveyard Carz for a week. But instead of getting things done, Daren starts inventing new field trips and distractions for the crew, as well as becoming obsessed with getting his personal Dodge Challenger running again.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: Mark receives an angry call from the owner of the 1970 Roadrunner, which leads to a mad rush to get the car finished in time. Meanwhile, Josh pushes the crew into committing to some New Years resolutions.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: Frustrated by the crew's complaints that he spends all day being lazy in the front office. Mark is determined to prove to the guys that there is more to restoring a car than physical labor. Josh and Daren visit the crash site of the mangled orange 1971 'Cuda.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: As the team works to complete a multitude of cars, Mark stresses over the metal dipping of the very rare and valuable ʻ71 Cuda 440-6. Tensions are high and time is limited, is the GYC crew up to the pressure?

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: The ghouls get the remains back from the '71 440 Six Barrel, 4 Speed, Shaker Hood Phantom Cuda and determine if the car can be resurrected. A '69 Dodge Daytona Charger arrives ready to be brought back from the dead and Mark gets a 2011 SRT8 Dodge Challenger.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: The ghouls get the N96 Air Grabber installed on the '71 Charger 440 Six Pack Triple Green car. It's started and is ready for final assembly. The owners of '70 Cuda 383 Automatic FE5 Rallye Red Car visit to check on the restoration progress.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: Mark is hired to restore the body, paint, and suspension of a '70 AAR Cuda 340 Six Barrel car. The shop gets some needed upgrades and the '71 Charger 440 Six Pack Triple Green car is completed to OEM Specifications.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: The '70 Sunroof Challenger is painted and ready for final assembly. The '69 Daytona Charger is disassembled and readied to be shipped to the media blasters. Mark and the Ghoulz head out to the junkyard to blow off some steam playing paintball.

programme.title: The Celestial Wars
programme.sub-title: The Short Adventures of Thistle & Arky
programme.desc: Who better to go poking around in goblin tunnels than the only members of the party who will fit inside?! But what Arky and Thistle find in the warrens is not what they expected…

programme.title: The Celestial Wars
programme.desc: The party finds the dwarven city of Iron Stone. Unfortunately, it is under siege by strange magical creatures. And what has become of that dangerous assassin, the Lovely Lute?

programme.title: The Celestial Wars
programme.desc: Coming upon the lava-fueled dwarven forge, the party begins to craft anti-magical emerald-imbued weapons. That is, until the whole building begins to shake...

programme.title: The Celestial Wars
programme.desc: Iron Stone is saved! As thanks, the party receives a bounty of magical crystals and a powerful new iron suit for Arky. Now they head for Rock Bottom, a duegar dwarf city beneath a waterfall in the dark Underground.

programme.title: The Celestial Wars
programme.desc: Reaching Pelion Darrus, the Party finds it under devastating attack from above and below. One hero makes an unexpected journey, dragging the party into a surprising decision in this weeks episode!

programme.title: The Celestial Wars
programme.desc: The Audio Dungeon crew begin their adventure in the world of Andaria. Finndelar (Tom) the wizard, and Hogar (Dan) the ranger, have just finished their two month journey, and have reached their destination; The Sunken City. Finn's mission is to retrieve a magical device created in part by a local craftsman: Arkie Fint. Hogar, an ally of Finn, was hired to guide and protect him. When they arrive, they find themselves in the midst of a large celebration, as well as a mystery regarding their mission...

programme.title: The Celestial Wars
programme.desc: Finndelar (Tom) and Hogar (Dan) have arrived in the Sunken City and are now searching for the magical device they have journeyed so far for. After meeting the craftsman Arkie Fint, they travel to Smithy's tavern in hope of finding a clue to their mystery...

programme.title: The Celestial Wars
programme.desc: Smithy's party has proven to be entertaining and everyone is enjoying themselves. Meanwhile, during the festivities, Bludgy, the city's most notorious thief is seen sneaking upstairs, drawing the attention of others. Finn and Hogar's mission hangs in the balance...

programme.title: The Celestial Wars
programme.desc: Finn and Hogar are tied up below Smithy's tavern along with a few others. Bludgy is about to sell off the crystal rod for a life changing amount ofgold, while Arkie is "retrieving" something important from his workshop.

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: Join Rush and his good friend Anthony Solmo for an epic day of fishing in the stunning waters of Key West, Florida! Leaving the Odyssea at the dock, they hop on a bay boat outfitted with a trolling motor for the ultimate inshore adventure. Gliding quietly through the shallows, they target a variety of species—including hard-pulling Tarpon and explosive topwater Jacks—leaving Rush thinking, “A guy could get used to this kind of fishing!”

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: SoCal summer is calling, and the Local Knowledge crew is back on Ali’s home turf in San Diego, California. With reports of hot bites and fish moving in, the crew faces a classic Southern California dilemma — chase big yellowtail around the Coronado Islands or head north in search of bluefin tuna. The options are plenty, the challenges are real, and that’s exactly what keeps fishing in SoCal so exciting.

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: When the yellowtail at the islands refuse to play, it’s time to switch up the game plan. Ali and Rush pivot north of San Diego in search of hard-charging bluefin tuna during a multi-day mission aboard the 43’ custom ACI Catamaran "Killer Bee". Armed with the right crew, the right gear, and a never-quit mindset, the guys roll the dice on an overnight move—hoping to wake up to redemption and put a few quality bluefin on deck.

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: Returning to Venice, Louisiana for the first time in nearly a decade, Rush reconnects with longtime friends Eric and Monique Newman of Journey South Outfitters for an unforgettable inshore fishing adventure in the heart of the Mississippi River Delta. With reports of massive schools of redfish cruising the beaches, Monique (“Moe”) must decide whether to trust the intel and make a bold run down the coast—or rely on her own instincts built from years on the water. The mission is simple: put Rush on a true bull redfish and see if he has what it takes to earn a spot in her coveted “Over 40-Inch Club.” This trip highlights why Venice, Louisiana is considered one of the premier inshore fisheries in the country—and why having the right guide makes all the difference. Target Species: Bull Redfish. Location: Venice, Louisiana – Mississippi Delta. Outfitter: Journey South Outfitters.

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: Water quality is everything—and the Star brite - SeaSafe team is back at it for the second year in a row! Led by Cory Redwine, Conservation Director of Project SeaSafe, this is the 4th Annual Clean Water Collective and it’s bigger than ever. This time, we’re in Grant, Florida, where 4 million clams are being released into the Indian River Lagoon, paired with the planting of thousands of mangroves, oyster work by CCA and trash clean ups to help restore one of Florida’s most critical ecosystems. But it’s not just about hard work—it’s about connection. With local captains, fishing legends, and the Local Knowledge crew on hand, we hit the water to show why this place is worth fighting for. From clam drops by drone, to in-water mangrove planting, to monster snook catches, this is hands-on conservation at its best. This two-part series kicks off with action, heart, and the kind of hope only a healthy waterway can bring. Don’t miss Part 1—where conservation meets community and everyone gets their hands wet.

programme.title: Local Knowledge

For Rush, that meant some serious bow time with close friend Alex Hughey - on the hunt for some of the biggest snook we've ever encountered. The bite wasn't easy, but that didn't stop Rush from smashing his personal best - not once, but twice - in one unforgettable day on the water. Don't miss this action-packed episode of the Sea Safe adventure from beautiful Sebastian, Florida!

programme.title: The Falls: Testament Of Love
programme.desc: The Falls: Testament of Love is a continuation of the story of RJ Smith and Chris Merrill, two Mormon missionaries that fell in love during their mission in a small town in Oregon. The boys haven't spoken in five years, but when an unexpected tragedy compells them back to the Oregon town where they served, they find themselves, once again, thrust into one another's lives. As old feelings begin to surface they find themselves again facing difficult choices. If they pursue their desire to be together, RJ and Chris risk hurting the ones they care about as they embark on a spiritual journey to discover love, freedom, and happiness.

programme.title: Elvis & Madona
programme.desc: Elvis & Madona is a romantic comedy that deals with an unusual subject in a delicate and realistic way: a love story between young lesbian Elvis and a transvestite Madona. The story takes place in Copacabana, neighborhood in Rio de Janeiro. The screenplay comprehends a full array of human types and, by following the journey of both protagonists, illustrates the conflicts generated by the evolution of behavior and custom. It is a modern and agile picture, and its soundtrack will follow the latest musical trends. Nevertheless, it is essentially a love story, proving that love can exist in any situation.

programme.title: The Aware Show
programme.sub-title: The Aware Show: Dr Jill Bolte Taylor - Whole Brain Living and Choice
programme.desc: Host Lisa Garr interviews Dr Jill Bolte Taylor, a Harvard-trained and published neuroanatomist. She shares with us the idea of cellular circuitry and how there are four distinct modules of cells that make up who we are, combining the thinking mind and the emotional side. She discusses her new book, Whole Brain Living: The Anatomy of Choice and the Four Characteristics that Drive Our Life.

programme.title: The Aware Show
programme.sub-title: The Aware Show: Robert Thurman - Wisdom is Bliss
programme.desc: Host Lisa Garr interviews Professor Robert Thurman, the preeminent scholar and interpreter of Tibetan Buddhist philosophy for the modern world, who believes that Wisdom is Bliss and in fact, that’s the name of his latest book. Thurman is a very close friend of HH Dalai Lama and today he discusses deep ideas about mindfulness and presence and leads us on a joyful exploration into the nature of reality through Buddha’s threefold curriculum.

programme.title: The Aware Show
programme.sub-title: The Aware Show: Dr Harley Rotbart - No Regrets Parenting
programme.desc: Host Lisa Garr interviews Dr. Harley Rotbart, a nationally renowned infectious diseases specialist, pediatrician, parenting expert, speaker, and educator who discusses his latest book No Regrets Parenting: Turning Long Days and Short Years into Cherished Moments with Your Kids. He shares special keys for parents to guide children to live a life of wonder and contentment by conscious parenting.

programme.title: The Aware Show
programme.sub-title: The Aware Show: Dr. Michael Tobin - Secrets to a Loving Relationship
programme.desc: Host Lisa Garr interviews marital and family psychologist Dr. Michael Tobin who believes the secret to a happy, long-lasting relationship is mutual respect for one another. He’s been with his life partner, soulmate, and wife, Deborah, for 47 years, and in practice as a psychologist for more than 45 years. His most recent book, Riding the Edge, A Love Song to Deborah, chronicles his six-month transformative journey.

programme.title: HealthDay

programme.title: HealthDay

programme.title: HealthDay

programme.title: HealthDay

programme.title: Yoga For All
programme.desc: Your day 5 practice introduces principles of stability or Sthira. Though this practice we learn to to steady the mind as we strengthen the body. Build on yesterday’s practice to marry effort with ease. Invite your breath to be smooth and even as we continue to build on your foundation.

programme.title: Yoga For All
programme.desc: Your day 6 practice invites you to use core work to get clear. In this session we use controlled movement to activate the muscles of the abdominal for a strong and healthy back and strengthen your whole self.

programme.title: Yoga For All
programme.desc: Your Day 7 practice is an invitation right to the good stuff. This fiery session is a warming sequence that guides to you create a healthy flow of energy in the body welcoming total mind and body health.

programme.title: Yoga For All
programme.desc: Your day 9 practice asks you to check in with body and breath as a way of cultivating more awareness. The journey continues! The vocabulary grows. Move fearlessly through this practice by simply listening to your body. Check your habits and move with intention as a way of moving forward with confidence and focus.

programme.title: Yoga For All
programme.desc: Your day 10 practice starts with a standing warm up and eases into a yoga flow for balance and transformation! Bring calm alertness to the mind and body as you continue to ride the wave of the breath. Build a strong foundation to set yourself up for greatness. Be patient and courageous.

programme.title: A Return To Wholeness
programme.sub-title: A Return To Wholeness - Human Nature vs. Modern Culture
programme.desc: As humans, we need interconnection: We rely on others to survive, especially as children. Yet, we also strive for authenticity. This creates an inherent tension. In this lesson, Dr. Maté discusses what is true human nature — and how the modern world has warped our understanding of our needs.

programme.title: A Return To Wholeness
programme.sub-title: A Return To Wholeness - Approaching Trauma with Curiosity and Compassion
programme.desc: Trauma is a wound that you sustain; it's not what happened to you. In this lesson, Dr. Maté explains why traumatic wounds get triggered and how to understand triggers in your process of transformation and healing.

programme.title: A Return To Wholeness
programme.sub-title: A Return To Wholeness - The Connection Between Health and Childhood Trauma
programme.desc: There is a strong link between childhood trauma and health challenges. Dr. Maté demonstrates how to untangle and understand this connection with self-compassion.

programme.title: A Return To Wholeness
programme.sub-title: A Return To Wholeness - The Social Roots of Suffering
programme.desc: Suffering has deep social causes. In this lesson, Dr. Maté explains how your physiology is impacted by stress and social determinants.

programme.title: The Work of Byron Katie
programme.desc: As humans, we are constantly struggling between the poles of what we think we want and what is. When we lose touch with the truth of what is, we create and compound our suffering. What narratives are you constructing? Are they in conflict with the truth of the situation? Are you struggling with what is?

programme.title: The Work of Byron Katie
programme.desc: The way you recall a memory and the way it actually happened might be completely different. The question is, do you know which version feeds you? We can become so wrapped up in our recollections, we convince ourselves of these untruths. Is that person a monster? Were they wishing you harm? Or were they dealing with a difficult situation in the best way they knew how?

programme.title: Amuse-gueule

programme.title: La Recette de Guy Martin S08

programme.title: Pays et marchés du monde
programme.sub-title: Pays et marches du monde - Kariba (Zimbabwe)
programme.desc: À chaque épisode, un voyage ! Xavier Petit, caméraman reporter, nous fait découvrir un pays, une ville, un peuple et, bien sûr, un marché traditionnel et une spécialité locale.

programme.title: Epicerie Fine S08
programme.desc: "Au coeur des montagnes des Hautes-Alpes, à Vars, Kévin Bonnabel élève des Limousines en axant sa pratique sur l'agroécologie. Éric François cultive du génépi, une plante emblématique des hautes altitudes. Forêts de mélèzes, chamois et bouquetins : gros plan sur le patrimoine vivant local."

programme.title: Donner l'gout
programme.desc: Miyano Sakai est la cheffe-propriétaire du Tora-Ya Ramen, un restaurant japonais dans le quartier Saint-Roch à Québec. On découvre avec elle les boîtes bento, les gyozas et la fameuse soupe ramen. Dégustation de sakés à la clé.

programme.title: Pique-Assiette
programme.desc: Au menu du jour : un clafoutis, mais aux fraises ! Le chef pâtissier Julien Boutonnet nous apprendra comment réussir son clafoutis avec des fruits qui, à priori, rendent beaucoup de jus en cuisant.

programme.title: Ricardo S20
programme.sub-title: Pizzas au poulet et bol de saumon marine
programme.desc: Deux recettes pour nous aider à simplifier les repas sans faire de compromis sur le goût : une pizza au poulet sur un pain naan au beurre et un bol express de saumon mariné au miso et au miel.

programme.title: Les Ambassadeurs 2025
programme.desc: "Pour rendre hommage à un épisode majeur de l'Histoire de la Belgique, la bataille des Ardennes, Nathalie Guirma se rend à Bastogne. Les habitants y célèbrent les héros américains venus secourir la ville encerclée par la contre-offensive allemande, il y a maintenant quatre-vingts ans."

programme.title: Safran & saveurs by chef Simo
programme.sub-title: Crepe salee facon pastilla de poulet aux amandes
programme.desc: Chef Simo marie la tradition marocaine et la finesse française avec une crêpe façon pastilla, sublimée par des amandes et une touche d'Auvergne. Fusion exquise !

programme.title: La Recette de Guy Martin S08
programme.sub-title: Tarte fine au confit de poivrons et anchois
programme.desc: Le chef étoilé Guy Martin présente les produits emblématiques du terroir français et propose une recette pour les accommoder.

programme.title: Donner l'gout
programme.desc: Hélène fait la connaissance de Maria et de Zoya, le duo mère-fille derrière Le Virunga, un restaurant panafricain à Montréal. Ensemble, elles embarquent Hélène en plein coeur de l'Afrique en lui faisant découvrir une cuisine diversifiée, colorée et gourmande.

programme.title: Pique-Assiette
programme.sub-title: Comme un taboule aux legumes d'ete
programme.desc: Le jeune chef Gilles Varone nous prépare une salade aux légumes d'été inspirée du taboulé.

programme.title: Ricardo S20
programme.desc: Ricardo cuisine un légume-racine en dessert : des cupcakes à la betterave recouverts de crème au mascarpone et arrosés d'un sirop à la betterave.

programme.title: Les Ambassadeurs 2025
programme.desc: À l'occasion des 30 ans du parc Pairi Daiza, un voyage sur les cinq continents, à la rencontre de plus de 7 500 animaux, avec Éric Domb, son fondateur, et Catherine Vancsok, directrice scientifique. Avec aussi le curry de Laurence Vieujant et un city trip à Nantes.

programme.title: Safran & saveurs by chef Simo
programme.desc: Chef Simo réinvente le baghrir marocain avec une farce aux amandes, dattes et fleur d'oranger. Une explosion de saveurs qui mêle authenticité et créativité !

programme.title: Epicerie Fine S08
programme.desc: "Dans cette partie de la Bresse située en Saône-et-Loire, Jean-Thomas Vuillard est pisciculteur ; Alexandre Cauchy, producteur de piment et maraîcher. À découvrir en compagnie d'Aurélien Poirel : les espèces de la réserve naturelle nationale de Truchère-Ratenelle. Atelier plumes avec Estelle Petiot, à l'écomusée de la Bresse bourguignonne."

programme.title: Epicerie Fine S08
programme.desc: "Entre Haute-Loire et Ardèche, les grands espaces du Mézenc se découvrent avec Valérie Courbon, productrice de fruits rouges, et Florian Gibaud, éleveur. Sortie marmottes avec Alexandre Aubry, accompagnateur en montagne ; sensibilisation des randonneurs à la préservation du mont Mézenc avec Sébastien Michel, médiateur et guide nature."

programme.title: Donner l'gout
programme.desc: À la rencontre de Mitch et Boom, le duo à la tête de La Belle Tonki, un restaurant vietnamien de Montréal. Hélène découvre aussi Anh, la mère de Mitch, qui lui confie les secrets d'une bonne soupe phó.

Également : Totemus à Saint-Remy-Geest ; la ferme de Benoît Custine à la Roche-en-Ardenne ; l'univers des Baladins du miroir.

programme.title: Prueba de Fe
programme.desc: En Lima la ciencia y la religión trabajan de la mano para revelar al mundo el verdadero rostro de Santa Rosa de Lima. Mientras tanto en un pueblo apartado una médico rural será testigo de un hecho milagroso que cambiará su vida y la de una niña que fue maltratada y encerrada, al igual que la Santa de Amêrica.

programme.title: Una Navidad Complicada
programme.desc: En medio de la temporada navideña, Leticia y Guillermo, divorciados desde hace años, enfrentan una situación inesperada cuando su hijo adolescente recurre a una trampa para reunirlos, falsificando un correo electrónico conde invita a Guillermo y su nueva novia a la casa familiar para Navidad. A medida que la forzada convivencia avanza, la relación entre Guillermo y su exesposa va cambiando. Guillermo descubre cuanto extraña su antigua vida, su vida familiar estable y hermosa. Y descubre que sigue amando a Leticia. Pero, para regresar definitivamente, necesita ganarse el perdón de Leticia y demostrarle que está dispuesto a cambiar. No es tan fácil, pero tal vez el espíritu navideño ayude a que suceda el milagro.

programme.title: La Mejor Navidad
programme.desc: Desde su divorcio, la ambiciosa Gloria ha dedicado todo su tiempo y su atención a su trabajo en Miami. Incluso sus hijos han pasado a un segundo plano. Cuando las circunstancias la obligan a pasar una navidad en familia en el rancho de su exmarido Eduardo en un pequeño pueblo de Jalisco, descubre que la felicidad y el amor suelen esconderse en las cosas más simples.

programme.title: Un Papa Para Navidad
programme.desc: Rebeca es una estrella de las redes. Se ha dejado encandilar de tal manera por la fama y el reconocimiento que su familia ha pasado a segundo plano. Pero una navidad un desconocido se presenta en su puerta afirmando que es su padre. Y aquel encuentro ayudará a Rebeca a recuperar lo verdaderamente importante en la vida.

programme.title: El Sabor de la Navidad
programme.desc: Una pequeña empresa familiar de Rompope enfrenta una encrucijada cuando una transnacional decide cerrar sus puertas en plena temporada navideña. Gregorio, un ambicioso ejecutivo, es el encargado de supervisar el cierre de la empresa local. Pero, al llegar, es recibido con calidez y hospitalidad por los trabajadores de la empresa, especialmente por Erica, la directora de la planta, que cree que su intención es aumentar la producción. Poco a poco Gregorio se sumerge en la magia de la comunidad, comenzando a cuestionar sus propias lealtades y enamorándose del lugar y de Erica. Gregorio terminará enfrentando a su empresa para salvar a la embotelladora y a sus trabajadores y así ganarse el corazón de Erica.

programme.title: Escandalos - Detras Del Presidente
programme.desc: El grupo de guardaespaldas del presidente de una poderosa nación llega de avanzada a una pequeña isla del Caribe donde se realizará un encuentro de mandatarios. Allí se involucran en juergas de prostitutas, dañando la imagen del encuentro y del gobierno al que están representando.

programme.title: Prueba de Fe
programme.desc: En Lima la ciencia y la religión trabajan de la mano para revelar al mundo el verdadero rostro de Santa Rosa de Lima. Mientras tanto en un pueblo apartado una médico rural será testigo de un hecho milagroso que cambiará su vida y la de una niña que fue maltratada y encerrada, al igual que la Santa de Amêrica.

programme.title: Juntos Esta Navidad
programme.desc: Tras una ruptura amorosa, ISABEL decide alquilar una pequeña casita navideña en un apartado pueblito, para pasar la temporada decembrina trabajando en su libro. Pero el viudo JUAN ANDRÉS y su hija LAURITA han tenido la misma idea. Por un error les alquilan la misma casa. La zona está llena por la temporada y se ven obligados a compartir el lugar, en principio por una noche. Pero una serie de circunstancias hacen que la situación se alargue. La magia navideña hace de las suyas y, poco a poco, entre ISABEL y JUAN ANDRÉS surge una atracción muy especial.

programme.title: Intercambio Navideno
programme.desc: MAYA y ANA MARÍA son gemelas. Pero fueron separadas al nacer y entregadas a diferentes familias. Fueron criadas de maneras opuestas. ANA MARÍA es ahora una exitosa empresaria divorciada, que solo piensa en su éxito y en el trabajo. MAYA una incansable filántropa, criada por una familia que se dedica a trabajar en pro de los más necesitados. Ya adultas se descubren una a la otra y deciden guardar el secreto, para no hacer daño a sus familias. Pero una navidad deciden hacer la travesura de intercambiar sus vidas por una noche. Sin sospechar que aquella decisión las cambiará para siempre.

programme.title: Mi Amor en Navidad
programme.desc: LUCAS es un famoso cantante. Su tema navideño “Mi Amor en Navidad” ha sido un hit desde hace casi dos décadas. Pero ya no siente deseos de seguir interpretando esta canción. Un diciembre decide tomarse unas vacaciones para reflexionar sobre su carrera y sobre su futuro y regresa al pueblo donde creció. Allí se rencuentra con ELISA, su amor de juventud y conoce a JORGE, el hijo adolescente de ELISA, que sueña con llegar a ser músico. A través de ellos se conecta con sus raíces y sus recuerdos y consigue de nuevo esos motivos que una vez lo enamoraron de la música, de la navidad… ¡y de Elisa!

programme.title: Una Deliciosa Navidad
programme.desc: Máximo y Luciana son amantes de la cocina. Pero hasta allí llegan sus coincidencias. Él es un prestigioso chef apasionado por la comida molecular, y ella es una cocinera intuitiva empeñada en rescatar los sabores de su tierra. Cuando el destino los junta, en plena Navidad, en el restaurante que Máximo hereda de su padre y que Luciana regenta, la combinación es explosiva. Pero también deliciosa.

programme.title: Stepdads The Sketch- Ep 1
programme.desc: When infidelity claims the life of Joanne Bates, her children Lisa and Stevie are left in the custody of her fiancé Mike and his brother Jerry. Mike, a straight-laced, hardworking accountant; and Jerry, a wild, unstable, womanizer were both former foster children and together they provide a unique balance of parenting skills for young Lisa and Stevie. - Step Dads starring Ben Sloane (R.I.P.D, Alpha House), Morocco Omari (Empire, 21 Bridges, Homeland, Chicago Fire), Jorie Binion (Chicago P.D) Charles Dunlap (Chicago Fire, Empire), and Jay Davis (Not Another Black Movie, Choke On That: The Series, Not Another Zombie Movie) is a comedy about two polar opposite foster brothers raising two children using non-traditional parenting methods while shedding a satirical light on the importance of adoption. We poke fun at some of the mishaps which comes along with the shock of being a new parent, but ultimately, we hope to spread awareness on adoption, the importance of having fathers and father-figures in the lives of young people, and having a familial loving environment. The moral of our story is that “No family is perfect, but every child deserves to be loved unconditionally, and raised in a reliable, stable support system.”

programme.title: Not Another Black Movie
programme.desc: Not Another Black Movie stars Damon Williams (Bad Boys of Comedy, Comic View, BET LIVE, The Tom Joyner Morning Show), Janet Hubert (The Fresh Prince of Bel-Air), Rodney Perry (The Monique Show, Who's Got Jokes) Jay Davis (Not Another Zombie Movie, Shots Fired), and Leon Rogers (WGCI, Comic View, Bad Boys of Comedy). - Not Another Black Movie is not only a spoof of a genre often associated with Tyler Perry films, but a satirical look at family dysfunction as well. Written by Jay Davis and Directed by Donte "Diesel" Williams, Not Another Black Movie addresses issues that effect many families whether they be rich or poor, black or white. Although we poke fun at some of the stereotypical roles portrayed in this genre, we hope to shed some light on problems that plague many families while giving you a good laugh.
